inputs.text: [anxious] Harry, are you hurt? You're holding your breath. I need you to tell me if it caught you.
[breathless] It didn't. I thought it had for a second. Listen to the orchestra. There are two beats before each one lands.
[anxious] You heard that while it was coming at your head? I heard the ice hit. I didn't hear anything before it.
[breathless] I wasn't listening the first time either. But it's the same phrase. If I'm right, we can move before it chooses where we're standing.
[anxious] And if you're wrong, we're moving into an arrow instead of away from one. Tell me exactly what you want me to do.
[breathless] Come across me on the second beat. Not away from me, across. I'll turn us. I know it looks too narrow, but I think there's room.
[anxious] I thought we'd left it too late. For a moment I couldn't tell if you'd moved or if I'd pulled you down.
[breathless] You didn't pull me down. I nearly tripped over my own foot. Please don't tell me you thought I had that under control.
